connector.name: Graph-Mem
connector.registryDescription: Persistent knowledge-graph memory for AI agents, with local semantic search. No API keys.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package graphmem-mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the sathvik-1007 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: GRAPHMEM_DB_PATH
env.description: Path to the SQLite database file. Defaults to .graphmem/graph.db relative to the working directory.

env.name: GRAPHMEM_EMBEDDING_MODEL
env.description: sentence-transformers model ID used for semantic search. Defaults to all-MiniLM-L6-v2, downloaded on first use.

env.name: GRAPHMEM_TRAVERSAL_NODE_BUDGET
env.description: Maximum entities visited by a single graph traversal. Defaults to 5000.

env.name: GRAPHMEM_LOG_LEVEL
env.description: Logging verbosity: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, or CRITICAL. Defaults to WARNING.
